name: Build A Farm! 🌽
desc:
Welcome to Build a Farm! 🌽

🛠️ HOW TO PLAY:

🌱 Buy Seeds from the shop and start growing your farm!
🚜 Plant, grow, and harvest crops to earn Cash!
🏡 Upgrade and decorate your farm to make it your own!
✨ Unlock rare and valuable plants as you progress!
🌙 Offline growth — your crops keep growing even when you’re away!

Like & Favorite the game for more Updates!
